# Status

48 capabilities are shipped and 19 are planned, as of 2026-10-08. **Shipped** means implemented on `main` and held by a named test in the repository; `conductor-docs` generates this page and `website/data/status.json` from one list and fails when a test it names is gone. **Planned** means a draft on the repository's plan, not built.

## Snapshot collectors

| Capability | Status | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| [GitHub repositories, pull requests and CI](./reference/cli.md#conductor-snapshot-start-snapshot) | ● shipped | A snapshot records each repository of the instance's GitHub owners with its open pull requests and the latest runs on main, read with gh. |
| Local checkout state | ● shipped | A repository with a checkout is recorded with its local state, its latest release and its planning store. |
| Live sessions | ● shipped | Each live agent session is recorded with the repository its working directory lies in. |
| Blockers | ● shipped | The open blocker artifacts each repository's planning store holds on origin/main are recorded after a fetch. |
| Specifications | ● shipped | Each repository's specification is read on origin/main, one per repository, archived ones left out. |
| Releases and merged pull requests | ● shipped | A snapshot records the releases and merged pull requests of its window. |
| [Catalog membership](./reference/config.md) | ● shipped | When the instance names a catalog, each recorded repository says whether the catalog lists it. |
| A silent source fails the snapshot | ● shipped | A source that does not answer fails the snapshot and keeps what was already recorded. |
| Codex thread goals | ○ planned | A snapshot reads the operator's Codex thread goals, read-only. |
| Dependency map | ○ planned | Which repository depends on which, read from their manifests rather than declared. |

## Store and views

| Capability | Status | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| Every observation reads back | ● shipped | Each observation kind a snapshot records is answered by its view. |
| Views create nothing | ● shipped | A view on a missing store exits 1 and creates nothing. |
| [Store migration](./reference/cli.md#conductor-store-migrate) | ● shipped | store migrate moves an older store into the tree store, and every view answers as before. |
| [Observation retention](./reference/config.md) | ● shipped | Only the observations of the newest complete snapshots are kept, 12 unless the instance says otherwise. |
| [Release digest](./reference/cli.md#conductor-repository-shipped) | ● shipped | repository shipped lists each release with what merged before it, and the rest as not released. |
| [Repository activity and marks](./reference/cli.md#conductor-repository-activity) | ● shipped | A mark overrides the activity computed from the newest complete snapshot. |
| Append-cost test on a loaded host | ○ planned | The store's append-cost test holds on a busy machine instead of failing the gate. |
| Status board | ○ planned | snapshot publish-board writes STATUS.md from the newest complete snapshot. |
| Focus per goal | ○ planned | The board says what the organization is working on, one line per goal. |

## Goals, resources and controllers

| Capability | Status | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| Goals | ● shipped | A goal is proposed, confirmed and met, and a goal confirmed twice is refused. |
| Resource ledger | ● shipped | Build slots and other resources are requested, granted, released and refused through one ledger. |
| Controller records | ● shipped | One controller runs per repository, through pause, resume, charter revision and stop. |
| Starting a controller launches its session | ○ planned | start-controller starts the controller's session, not only its record. |
| Codex controller profile | ○ planned | A controller profile for Codex sessions, beside the Claude one. |
| A controller starts on less reading | ○ planned | A controller's start-of-session reading shrinks, so it reaches its hand-over later. |

## Decisions

| Capability | Status | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| Requests, escalation and answers | ● shipped | A decision request is escalated to the operator and answered. |
| Decision authority | ● shipped | A class-O decision recorded as conductor's is refused and nothing is kept. |
| Decision ids | ● shipped | Decision ids are allocated per UTC date, and concurrent records get distinct ones. |
| A decision names its goal and value | ○ planned | A decision records the goal it serves and the value or principle it rests on. |

## Dispatches and messages

| Capability | Status | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| Dispatch lifecycle | ● shipped | A dispatch moves from sent through started, blocked and done, and another is cancelled. |
| Dispatch ids | ● shipped | Dispatch ids are allocated per UTC day, and a hand-given id that exists is refused. |
| Message formats | ● shipped | Each first-line message format is parsed into its kind. |
| A message that does not parse is answered with the format | ● shipped | A message whose first line names no format is rejected with the format, not acted on. |
| Harness-neutral mailbox | ○ planned | Messages between sessions travel as files, so sessions of different harnesses reach each other. |
| Restart and ready messages | ○ planned | The restart message, the ready report and the conductor-dev actor are in the specification. |

## Guard

| Capability | Status | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| Controller write boundary | ● shipped | A controller writes in its own checkout and its managed worktrees, and nowhere else. |
| Message boundary | ● shipped | A controller messages conductor and the agents it started, and no one else. |
| No GitHub writes from a controller | ● shipped | A controller reads GitHub and makes no write there. |
| [The hook and its record](./reference/cli.md#conductor-guard-record-guard-decision) | ● shipped | The hook denies with exit 2, allows with exit 0, and records each denial. |
| An allowance never opens the store | ● shipped | An allowed tool call is answered with exit 0 without opening the store. |
| Settings wire the guard | ● shipped | The controller settings file wires the guard on the five tools it checks. |
| Every tool call is guarded | ○ planned | Every tool call reaches the guard, and a tool it does not know is denied. |
| Bash writes bounded by the sandbox | ○ planned | Shell writes are bounded by the harness sandbox rather than by parsing commands. |
| A store timeout is not a denial | ○ planned | When the guard cannot record its verdict in time it says so, rather than deny the tool call. |
| Sibling trees of one repository | ○ planned | A relative cd into another managed tree of the same repository is not taken for another repository. |

## Watch

| Capability | Status | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| [Session exits](./reference/cli.md#conductor-watch-run) | ● shipped | A session gone from the session list is reported, and a start is not. |
| Rate limits | ● shipped | A fresh rate limit is reported once a day, with a notification. |
| Context threshold | ● shipped | Conductor's context above the hand-over threshold is reported once per session. |
| Main CI | ● shipped | Main's CI turning red, and green again, is reported on a CI pass. |

| Free-disk reading matches df | ○ planned | The watch's free-disk reading agrees with df on the same filesystem. |
| Largest managed trees | ○ planned | The watch reports the largest managed trees by size. |
